title:
一、英譯中：請將下列英文句子譯成中文。（15 分）
Our modern society often prides itself on its free press. With access to the Internet and cable television, the news is broadcast twenty-four hours a day. However, we have just completed a study which reveals that the general public is increasingly ill-informed today.
answer: 我們的現代社會常以擁有新聞自由為傲。由於可以透過網際網路與有線電視取得資訊，新聞全天二十四小時播送。然而，我們剛完成的一項研究顯示，今日一般大眾反而愈來愈資訊不足（愈來愈被錯誤資訊誤導）。
hint:
句構拆解
  • Our modern society often prides itself on its free press.：pride oneself on＝以……為傲；free press＝新聞自由。
  • With access to the Internet and cable television,：介系詞片語表原因或條件（由於能接觸網路與有線電視）。
  • the news is broadcast twenty-four hours a day：被動式；twenty-four hours a day＝全天二十四小時。
  • However, we have just completed a study which reveals that...：關係子句＋名詞子句；reveals that＝顯示……。
  • the general public is increasingly ill-informed today：increasingly＝愈來愈；ill-informed＝資訊不足的、被誤導的。
關鍵詞
  • pride oneself on 以……為傲
  • free press 新聞自由
  • access to 取得、接觸
  • ill-informed 資訊不足的、被錯誤資訊誤導的
翻譯技巧
  • 「With access to...」不要直譯「隨著接近」，譯「由於可以透過……取得資訊」較順。
  • however 的轉折要保留，中文用「然而」置於句首。
  • ill-informed 有「被餵錯資訊」的意味，譯「資訊不足」或「被誤導」都可，但不宜譯成「無知」（語氣太重）。
易錯點
  • 把 free press 譯成「免費報紙」——此處是「新聞自由」。
  • 把 a study 漏譯成「研究顯示」而失去「我們剛完成」的時態（have just completed）。

title:
二、中譯英：請將下列中文句子譯成英文。（15 分）
因為我們每次開車、煮飯或開燈都製造出二氧化碳，且這種氣體可在大氣層存在約一個世紀，二氧化碳在大氣中的比例迅速上升。
answer: Because every time we drive, cook, or turn on a light we produce carbon dioxide, and because this gas can remain in the atmosphere for about a century, the proportion of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere is rising rapidly.
hint:
句構策略
  • 全句是「因為 A，且因為 B，所以 C」的因果長句，英文用 Because..., and because..., the proportion... is rising rapidly. 兩個 because 並列。
  • 「每次開車、煮飯或開燈」→ every time we drive, cook, or turn on a light（用 every time 引導時間副詞子句）。
  • 「這種氣體可在大氣層存在約一個世紀」→ this gas can remain in the atmosphere for about a century。
  • 主要子句：the proportion of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere is rising rapidly（現在進行式表持續上升）。
關鍵詞
  • 二氧化碳 carbon dioxide (CO2)
  • 大氣層 the atmosphere
  • 比例 the proportion／the share
  • 迅速上升 rise rapidly／increase sharply
  • 存在 remain／stay
加分寫法
  • 也可用 Since... 代替第一個 because，但兩個 because 並列時語氣更清楚。
  • 「每次……都」除了 every time，也可用 whenever：whenever we drive, cook, or turn on a light。
易錯點
  • 「開燈」不要譯成 open the light，應為 turn on a light／turn on the lights。
  • 「存在約一個世紀」的介系詞用 for about a century，不是 in。
  • 主詞是「比例」，動詞用單數 is rising。

title:
三、英文作文：（20 分）
Write an essay in which you describe a moment in your life when you learned something you had never known before (suggested length: 200 words).
answer:
The lesson I remember most clearly was not taught in a classroom. It came on a rainy afternoon when I was sixteen, volunteering at a food bank in my hometown.

I had signed up expecting to feel useful. Instead, I spent three hours sorting expired bread and, by the end, I was quietly judging the people who came to collect it. One of them, a man in a faded jacket, thanked me and said, almost apologetically, that he had been an engineer for twenty years before the factory closed. I said something foolish about trying harder. He smiled and asked whether I had ever applied for a job I was overqualified for and been told I was too old.

That conversation lasted ten minutes, but it dismantled something I had believed my whole life: that success is simply a reward for effort. I had never known—really known—that luck, timing, and a closed factory could matter as much as hard work. Since then I have tried to ask questions before forming judgments, especially about people whose circumstances I cannot see.

I still believe in effort. But I no longer believe it is the whole story, and that is the most useful thing I have ever learned.
hint:
審題
  • 題目要求描述一個時刻（a moment），並說明學到什麼以前不知道的事；必須是敘事，不是議論。
  • 建議長度 200 字左右；三段或四段皆可。
  • 選一個具體、有畫面的事件（志工、旅行、課堂、家庭），比抽象的道理更得分。
四段架構
  • 第一段（背景）：時間、地點、當時的預期（我以為……）。
  • 第二段（事件）：具體對話或細節，呈現「我原本的想法」被挑戰的那一刻。
  • 第三段（轉折）：我學到什麼？以前的認知錯在哪裡？
  • 第四段（結論）：這個體悟如何改變我現在的行為。
關鍵詞彙
  • volunteer at a food bank 在食物銀行當志工
  • judge someone 評斷某人；assumption 預設、成見
  • dismantle a belief 拆解某個信念
  • overqualified 資歷過高；circumstances 處境
  • reward for effort 努力的回報
加分句型
  • I had signed up expecting to..., Instead,...（預期與現實的對比）
  • That conversation lasted ten minutes, but it dismantled something I had believed my whole life.（短暫對話、深遠影響）
  • I had never known—really known—that...（破折號強調）
  • I still believe in X. But I no longer believe it is the whole story.（讓步＋轉折收尾）
評分重點
  • 敘事要有時間軸與細節，不要只寫感想。
  • 時態：事件用過去式，體悟用現在完成式（Since then I have tried...）。
  • 結尾要回到題目「learned something never known before」。

title: The population in Los Angeles is ______ Hispanic American. More than half of the people there speak Spanish.
hint:
1. The population in Los Angeles is predominantly Hispanic American. More than half of the people there speak Spanish.
（洛杉磯的人口以拉丁裔美國人為主。當地超過一半的人說西班牙語。）
  • 考點：predominantly＝主要地、占多數地（形容詞 predominant）。
  • 線索：More than half of the people（超過一半）→ 表示「以……為主」。
  • 其他選項：officially 官方地；subsequently 隨後；ultimately 最終。
  • 例句：The area is predominantly residential.（這一區以住宅為主。）
撇步
  • 「占多數、以……為主」→ predominantly（近義：mostly、mainly）。

title: Sandy always teaches evening classes, but today she is ______ for a sick teacher in the morning class.
hint:
2. Sandy always teaches evening classes, but today she is substituting for a sick teacher in the morning class.
（珊迪一向教夜間課程，但今天她代一位生病老師的早班課。）
  • 考點：substitute for＝代替（某人／某物）；此處是「代課」。
  • 句構：but 表對比：always teaches evening classes ↔ today substituting in the morning class。
  • 其他選項：search for 尋找；strive for 力求；stalk 跟蹤。
  • 例句：She substituted for the history teacher last week.（她上週代歷史老師的課。）
撇步
  • 代課／代班＝substitute for / fill in for。

title: We were ______ after a long day of canoeing, so the roasted chicken over the campfire smelled heavenly.
hint:
3. We were ravenous after a long day of canoeing, so the roasted chicken over the campfire smelled heavenly.
（划了一整天獨木舟後我們飢腸轆轆，所以營火上烤雞的香味簡直是人間美味。）
  • 考點：ravenous＝極度飢餓的、狼吞虎嚥的。
  • 線索：long day of canoeing（划一整天船）＋roasted chicken smelled heavenly（烤雞香得不得了）→ 非常餓。
  • 其他選項：bleached 漂白的；genuine 真誠的；stringent 嚴格的。
  • 例句：After the hike we were ravenous.（健行之後我們餓壞了。）
撇步
  • 餓的程度：hungry ＜ starving ＜ ravenous（極餓）。

title: The speaker did not deliver her message in an overt manner when she stated ______ about her criticism of the government's policy to deport the illegal immigrants in the country.
hint:
4. The speaker did not deliver her message in an overt manner when she stated implicitly about her criticism of the government's policy to deport the illegal immigrants in the country.
（講者並未公開表達訊息，她是以隱含的方式表達對政府遣返非法移民政策的批評。）
  • 考點：implicitly＝隱含地、含蓄地；與 overt（公開的）相反。
  • 線索：did not deliver... in an overt manner（沒有公開表達）→ 所以是「隱含地」。
  • 其他選項：impulsively 衝動地；imminently 即將發生地；immensely 極度地。
  • 例句：She implicitly criticized the plan.（她含蓄地批評了那項計畫。）
撇步
  • 對比記：explicitly 明示地 ↔ implicitly 隱含地。

title: The president, hailing a “new era” to bring hopes to his people in the country, was ______ last month.
hint:
5. The president, hailing a “new era” to bring hopes to his people in the country, was inaugurated last month.
（這位總統宣示一個「新時代」為國人帶來希望，已於上月就職。）
  • 考點：inaugurate＝為……舉行就職典禮、正式就任。
  • 線索：president（總統）＋hailing a “new era”（宣示新時代）→ 就職。
  • 其他選項：yield 讓步、屈服；execute 處決、執行；terminate 終止。
  • 例句：The new president will be inaugurated in January.（新總統將於一月就職。）
撇步
  • 總統、市長、校長「就職」→ be inaugurated；名詞是 inauguration。

title: A big hole in the car park at SpaceX's headquarters in Los Angeles is the first visible evidence of another of Elon Musk's ventures. Mr. Musk who, besides leading SpaceX, a rocket company, also    6    Tesla, a maker of electric cars, is going into the tunneling business. The goal of the Boring Company, as he dubs his new enterprise, is to    7    into tunnels faster and more cheaply than is possible at the moment.    8    the pit in the car park, Mr. Musk says he has also begun a series of test tunnels for a project that will, if it comes to    9   , carry cars under Los Angeles on high-speed sledges. In this way, people can    10    the dreadful traffic jams above. More ambitiously, he claims to have official support for a 320 km (200-mile) tunnel that would, in half an hour, whisk people between New York and Washington, DC, in magnetically propelled capsules, using a technology he has dubbed the hyperloop.

subItems.hint:
6. Mr. Musk who, besides leading SpaceX, a rocket company, also runs Tesla, a maker of electric cars, is going into the tunneling business.
（馬斯克先生除了領導火箭公司 SpaceX，也經營電動車製造商特斯拉，如今要進軍隧道事業。）
  • 考點：關係子句 who... also runs Tesla；主詞 Mr. Musk 為第三人稱單數，動詞加 -s。
  • 干擾：插入語 besides leading SpaceX 不影響主詞與動詞的一致。
  • 其他選項：ran（過去式）、run（原形／複數）、running（分詞）。
撇步
  • 主詞後有逗號插入語時，動詞仍與真正的主詞一致。

7. The goal ... is to dig into tunnels faster and more cheaply than is possible at the moment.
（其目標是以比目前更快、更便宜的方式挖掘隧道。）
  • 考點：dig into tunnels＝挖掘隧道；dig 的過去式是 dug。
  • 線索：tunneling business（隧道事業）→ 動作是「挖」。
  • 其他選項：open 打開；visit 參觀；destroy 摧毀。
撇步
  • 隧道、洞、地基 → 動詞用 dig。

8. Apart from the pit in the car park, Mr. Musk says he has also begun a series of test tunnels...
（除了停車場那個坑洞之外，馬斯克說他也已經開始一系列測試隧道……）
  • 考點：apart from＝除了……之外（另有、外加）。
  • 線索：後文 also begun（也開始了）→ 表示「除前述之外還有」。
  • 其他選項：according to 根據；in view of 有鑑於；in spite of 儘管。
撇步
  • 後句出現 also／besides／as well → 前面用 apart from。

9. ...a project that will, if it comes to fruition, carry cars under Los Angeles on high-speed sledges.
（這項計畫若能實現，將以高速滑橇把車輛載運通過洛杉磯地底。）
  • 考點：come to fruition＝實現、開花結果（固定片語）。
  • 線索：if it comes to ___（如果它……）→ 計畫「實現」。
  • 其他選項：mentioning 提及；frustration 挫折；blooming 開花（植物）。
撇步
  • 計畫、構想「實現」→ come to fruition（近義：materialize）。

10. In this way, people can avoid the dreadful traffic jams above.
（如此一來，民眾就能避開地面上可怕的交通壅塞。）
  • 考點：avoid＝避開（後接名詞或 V-ing）。
  • 線索：在地底行駛 → 可以「避開」地面塞車。
  • 其他選項：confront 面對；allow 允許；confine 限制。
撇步
  • 塞車、風險、錯誤 → 動詞用 avoid；面對才用 confront。

title:
The clever fool syndrome would explain why one controversial study of Harvard Business School students found that, after a flying start, the alumni (presumably among the ablest young men of their day) gradually slipped back to the general level inside their chosen management    11   . A Harvard graduate has no reason at all to suppose that he will manage more effectively than a less instructed contemporary. The Harvard man can only claim that he is more highly educated; and high education and high achievement in practical affairs don't necessarily go together. John F. Kennedy found that assembling America's brightest brains in Washington neither got bills    12    Congress nor avoided the Bay of Pigs; and many companies have discovered that business school diplomas are a thin    13    against incompetence.

An overwhelmingly large proportion of the highest and best American executives did study business. All this proves that an overwhelmingly large proportion of business-minded undergraduates got the real message, which is that a diploma will be good for their careers, starting with starting salaries. It does not follow that the education was of any other direct benefit either to the executive or his firm.    14   , of course, that the schooling was wasted. As a general rule, the wise man recruits the finest intelligence he can find; and good minds are far better for good training. The question is only whether academic training in subjects that seem to have some connection with management    15    the best education for managing, and that is something that nobody can prove either way.

subItems.hint:
11. ...gradually slipped back to the general level inside their chosen management hierarchies.
（……逐漸回落到他們所屬管理階層的一般水準。）
  • 考點：hierarchies＝階層、層級組織（hierarchy 的複數）。
  • 線索：management ___（管理……）＋slipped back to the general level（回落到一般水準）→ 指的是「管理階層」。
  • 其他選項：apparatuses 器械；premonitions 預感；assessments 評估。
撇步
  • 組織的「階層」→ hierarchy；management hierarchy＝管理階層。

12. ...neither got bills through Congress nor avoided the Bay of Pigs...
（……既沒能讓法案在國會通過，也沒能避免豬玀灣事件……）
  • 考點：get a bill through Congress＝讓法案在國會通過（through＝穿過、通過）。
  • 句構：neither A nor B（既不 A 也不 B）。
  • 其他選項：with、over、beyond 都無法表達「通過」。
撇步
  • 法案「通過」國會＝get/pass a bill through Congress。

13. ...business school diplomas are a thin defence against incompetence.
（……商學院文憑難以抵禦無能。）
  • 考點：a thin defence against＝對……薄弱的防禦（defence＝防禦）。
  • 線索：against incompetence（對抗無能）→ 需要「防禦」。
  • 其他選項：pretext 藉口；intuition 直覺；reconciliation 和解。
撇步
  • defence against 是固定搭配（防禦、防護）。

14. Nor does it follow, of course, that the schooling was wasted.
（當然，這並不表示學校教育就浪費了。）
  • 考點：Nor does it follow that...＝這並不表示……（it follows that＝由此可見；否定倒裝用 Nor）。
  • 句構：否定副詞 Nor 置句首 → 助動詞 does 提前（倒裝）。
  • 其他選項：It is not followed（被動，語意不通）；One follows；What follows。
撇步
  • 否定副詞（Nor、Never、Hardly）置句首 → 倒裝。

15. The question is only whether academic training in subjects that seem to have some connection with management is the best education for managing...
（問題只在於：與管理似乎有些關聯的學科訓練，是否就是最好的管理教育……）
  • 考點：whether 子句的主詞是 academic training（單數），動詞用 is。
  • 干擾：that seem to have... 是修飾 subjects 的關係子句，不是主要動詞。
  • 其他選項：does（助動詞，後面缺動詞）；and／or（連接詞，句構不通）。
撇步
  • 先刪掉關係子句，再判斷主詞與動詞：whether academic training ... is the best education。

title:
Issues concerning women's bodily integrity and autonomy, such as abortion, rape, and sterilization, are subject to strong opinions that give rise to equally charged political policies. As with other issues pertaining to women's bodies, prostitution discourse is largely concerned with determining whether this social practice is exploitative, empowering, or a consequence of immorality.

Prostitution is here defined as a social practice by which men gain sexual access to the bodies of predominantly women, children, and sometimes other men, through the exchange of money, goods, or housing. Prostitution, as a social construct, arises from “men's dominance and women's subordination.”

Most people take one of three salient positions on prostitution. The first position argues that prostitution is a consequence of deficient moral character. This position draws heavily from patriarchal and religious traditions that equate female sexuality with temptation and male sexuality with dominance and sanctioned insatiability. The second position, the “sex work” position, asserts that prostitution is a valid form of labor and argues that prostitution is not inherently harmful to women. This position further contends that women have a right to decide what they will do with their bodies and that sex work, though oppressive for some, is potentially both lucrative and empowering for other women. The third position asserts that prostitution is a consequence of social, political, and economic inequality and argues that women are predominantly conscripted into prostitution because of their social vulnerability. Political regulation of prostitution activity varies according to each nation's underlying economic and social justice commitments.

subItems.title: 16. According to the passage above, which of the following is NOT a major concern of the practice of prostitution?
subItems.hint:
→ Whether it is tempting.
（根據本文，下列何者不是性交易實務的主要關注點？→ 它是否誘人。）
  • 定位：第一段「...determining whether this social practice is exploitative（剝削的＝abusive）, empowering, or a consequence of immorality」——三個關注點都已列出。
  • 陷阱：文中確實出現 temptation（誘惑），但那是描述「父權與宗教傳統把女性性慾等同於誘惑」，不是「性交易實務的主要關注點」。
  • 其他選項：abusive（剝削）、empowering（賦權）、immoral（不道德）都明確出現在第一段。
撇步
  • 否定題先回文圈出三個關鍵詞，再把「只出現在別處」的選項挑出來。

subItems.title: 17. According to the passage, which of the following is true of the practice of prostitution?

options.text: Man's gaining sexual access to the body of different species should be sanctioned.
Patriarchal dominance is prevalent in the act of prostitution.

subItems.hint:
→ Patriarchal dominance is prevalent in the act of prostitution.
（下列何者為真？→ 父權支配在性交易行為中普遍存在。）
  • 定位：第二段「Prostitution, as a social construct, arises from “men's dominance and women's subordination.”」
  • 其他選項：(A) 不同物種（species）——文中只談人，且「應被認可」是曲解；(C) 性工作「傷害」女性從屬——語意颠倒，文中說性工作對某些人壓迫、對另一些人賦權；(D) 女性性慾本身有害——文中是「被等同於誘惑」，不是「有害」。
撇步
  • 細節題回文找原句：men's dominance and women's subordination → patriarchal dominance。

subItems.title: 18. According to the passage, which of the following is true of the prostitution discourse?

options.text: Prostitution is partially defined as exploitative sexuality.
Prostitution is part and parcel of social work.
Prostitution is empowered by enhancing morality.
Social vulnerability sanctions females' sexual inequality.

subItems.hint:
→ Prostitution is partially defined as exploitative sexuality.
（關於性交易的論述，下列何者為真？→ 性交易部分被定義為剝削性的性。）
  • 定位：第一段「prostitution discourse is largely concerned with determining whether this social practice is exploitative...」——剝削性是定義性爭議之一。
  • 其他選項：(B) 社會工作的一環——文中未這樣說（sex work 是另一個立場，不是 social work）；(C) 透過提升道德而被賦權——因果颠倒；(D) 社會脆弱性「認可」了女性的性不平等——文中說脆弱性使人被捲入，不是「認可」。
撇步
  • 注意選項偷換概念：sex work（性工作）≠ social work（社會工作）。

subItems.title: 19. According to the passage, what is the major reason prostitution is immoral?
subItems.hint:
→ Religious condemnation.
（根據本文，性交易被視為不道德的主要原因是什麼？→ 宗教譴責。）
  • 定位：第三段第一個立場「prostitution is a consequence of deficient moral character. This position draws heavily from patriarchal and religious traditions...」
  • 推論：「不道德」的立場主要來自宗教與父權傳統的譴責。
  • 其他選項：政治承諾、經濟活動、種族歧視——都不是文中「不道德」立場的來源。
撇步
  • 問「原因」→ 找該立場的來源（draws heavily from religious traditions）。

subItems.title: 20. Why may prostitution be argued to empower women?

options.text: Prostituted women could endure extensive sexual and physical violence.
Sex work is potentially harmful in that it is lucrative.
Women could liberate their body as they please.
Prostitution reflects women's demand for social justice.

subItems.hint:
→ Women could liberate their body as they please.
（為什麼有人主張性交易能賦權女性？→ 女性可以依自己的意願支配自己的身體。）
  • 定位：第三段第二個立場「women have a right to decide what they will do with their bodies... potentially both lucrative and empowering」。
  • 其他選項：(A) 忍受暴力——不是賦權；(B) 「有害因為賺錢」自相矛盾；(D) 反映社會正義需求——那是第三個立場（結構不平等），不是賦權論。
撇步
  • 三個立場要分清：道德論、性工作論（賦權）、結構不平等論。

title:
Earth Day, an event to increase public awareness of the world's environmental problems, is celebrated in the United States for the first time. It was the    21    of Senator Gaylord Nelson of Wisconsin, a staunch environmentalist who hoped to provide unity to the grassroots environmental movement and increase ecological awareness. “The    22    was to get a nationwide demonstration of concern for the environment so large that it would shake the political establishment out of its lethargy,” Senator Nelson said, “and, finally,    23    this issue permanently onto the national political agenda.” Earth Day indeed increased environmental awareness in America, and in July of that year the Environmental Protection Agency was established by special executive order to    24    and enforce national pollution legislation.

On April 22, 1990, the 20th anniversary of Earth Day, more than 200 million people in 141 countries    25    in Earth Day celebrations. Earth Day has been celebrated on different days by different groups internationally. The United Nations officially celebrates it on the vernal equinox, which usually occurs about March 21.

subItems.hint:
21. It was the brainchild of Senator Gaylord Nelson of Wisconsin...
（這是威斯康辛州參議員蓋洛德·尼爾森的構想。）
  • 考點：brainchild＝（某人的）構想、心血結晶（the brainchild of sb.）。
  • 線索：It was the ___ of Senator...（這是某參議員的……）→ 指「構想」。
  • 其他選項：stepchild 繼子；adopted child 養子；spoiled child 被寵壞的孩子。
撇步
  • 「某人的點子／計畫」＝the brainchild of sb.。

22. “The objective was to get a nationwide demonstration of concern for the environment so large that it would shake the political establishment out of its lethargy,” Senator Nelson said.
（尼爾森參議員說：「目標是發起全國性、規模大到足以讓政治體制從麻木中驚醒的環保示威。」）
  • 考點：objective＝目標（＝goal）。
  • 線索：was to get a nationwide demonstration（是要發起全國性示威）→ 這是「目標」。
  • 其他選項：objection 反對；setback 挫折；drawback 缺點。
撇步
  • 「目標是……」＝The objective / goal / aim was to...。

23. ...and, finally, to force this issue permanently onto the national political agenda.
（……並且最終把這個議題永久推上國家政治議程。）
  • 考點：與前面的 to get 平行的不定詞：The objective was to get... and, finally, to force...。
  • 句構：不定詞片語並列，故用 to force。
  • 其他選項：forcing（分詞）、force（原形，缺 to）、forced（過去式）。
撇步
  • 並列結構看前一個：to get → to force。

24. ...the Environmental Protection Agency was established by special executive order to regulate and enforce national pollution legislation.
（……環保署依特別行政命令成立，以管制並執行全國污染防治法規。）
  • 考點：regulate＝管制、規範（與 enforce 執行並列）。
  • 線索：and enforce national pollution legislation（並執行全國污染法規）→ 前面應是「管制」。
  • 其他選項：challenge 挑戰；constrain 限制；violate 違反。
撇步
  • 主管機關「管制＋執行」＝regulate and enforce，是固定搭配。

25. ...more than 200 million people in 141 countries participated in Earth Day celebrations.
（……141 個國家超過兩億人參與了地球日慶祝活動。）
  • 考點：participate in＝參與（＝take part in）。
  • 線索：in Earth Day celebrations（在地球日慶祝活動中）→ 「參與」。
  • 其他選項：escape 逃離；exclude 排除；persuade 說服。
撇步
  • 活動、典禮、比賽 → participate in。
